text:
Ravi: Quick heads-up: customer 'blue-ocean' reported spikes in v1 latency; digging shows many requests lack x-rw-client-version and are being routed to v1 by default. They just rolled SDK that will set v2 but rollout isn't finished.
Leah: Do we still treat missing header as explicit v1? I thought we had a heuristic based on tenant pinning + traffic fingerprinting.
Tomas: Current chain: header -> tenant pin -> tenant preference -> GLOBAL_DEFAULT (v1). No inference from payload currently.
Nina: Could we plumb a console toggle that says "prefer-latest-on-missing" per-tenant? That would let rollout cohorts flip routing without requiring clients to immediately send headers.
Ravi: I like that. Also need to make clear in UI that "prefer-latest-on-missing" is a routing preference only and billing attribution will show whether header was present.
Leah: For telemetry, we should tag events with version_source = one of [explicit_header, tenant_preference, default_global, inferred_seqlen]. Start with explicit_header vs others.
Tomas: Implementation note: add request.metadata.version_source and routed_version. Use those to drive the console drilldown and quota ledger.
Nina: On quota: if we route to v2 due to prefer-latest-on-missing, should tokens be counted against v2 quotas? Customers might be surprised if their v2 quota spikes because of a routing preference.
Ravi: Proposal: add token_tag = either attributed_version (routed_version) and requested_version (header if present else "-"), and show both in billing UI. So billing rows can group by requested_version and routed_version.
Leah: Also add a small grace-window policy: when prefer-latest-on-missing is enabled, we initially route only 25% of missing-header requests to v2 and sample outputs. If sampled diffs > threshold -> rollback.
Tomas: Good. We'll need an automated rollback rule: if v2 implicit requests 5xx rate > baseline*3 or perplexity drift > X then failover to v1 for that tenant.
Nina: We should avoid implementing any automatic global flips; keep per-tenant only. Otherwise we risk breaking many older clients.
Ravi: Agreed. Console copy: "Prefer latest when client version header is missing (per-tenant). Use during SDK rollouts. Routing only; billing attribution will show requested vs routed version." Nina please draft help center copy.
Nina: Will do. Also recommend a console badge on tenant pages showing percentage of headerless traffic and impact estimate.
Leah: Telemetry SQL to surface headerless split (for dashboards):
```sql
SELECT tenant_id,
  sum(case when headers['x-rw-client-version'] is null then tokens else 0 end) as tokens_headerless,
  sum(tokens) as tokens_total,
  sum(case when metadata->>'version_source' = 'explicit_header' then tokens else 0 end) as tokens_explicit
FROM request_events
WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '24 hours'
GROUP BY tenant_id
ORDER BY tokens_headerless DESC
```
Tomas: We'll also need a tiny eval harness to compare v1 vs v2 outputs on identical payloads sampled from headerless traffic. Suggest storing N=2000 pairs per tenant during the 25% probe.
Ravi: Ops run: I'll push a short-lived routing override for blue-ocean: prefer-latest-on-missing=true, probe-weight=25%, window=1h. ops-bot please record.
ops-bot: deploy: routing-override-blue-ocean started by Ravi - probe_weight=25%, window=60m
Leah: I'll add the telemetry tags and a dashboard widget to surface requested_vs_routed table. Tomas: can you do the fallback rule?
Tomas: Yep. Fallback rule: if implicit routed v2 error_rate_5xx > 0.5% absolute increase vs baseline or if average eval similarity < 0.75 then automatically set runtime route-back to v1 for missing-header requests and alert #eng-runtime.
Nina: For console UX, try to make the toggle discoverable in the tenant rollout panel with a small learn-more modal explaining billing and safety nets.
Ravi: Post-mortem housekeeping: capture counts pre/post for 48h and share with customer success. If probe looks stable after 1h we can suggest they flip the toggle to 100%.
Leah: Action items:
- Ravi: start probe override for blue-ocean (done) + coordinate with CS
- Leah: telemetry tags, dashboard widget, billing attribution schema
- Tomas: fallback-on-error automation + eval sampling harness
- Nina: console copy + tenant badge + help center doc
ops-bot: deploy: routing-override-blue-ocean completed - status=active, probe_weight=25%
Ravi: First 20 minutes: errors stable, sampled outputs look similar. Continuing to monitor. Thanks all.
